title: Of Men and Galaxies
question: What is the most influential factor in any human society?

meanings.meaning: 有影响力的，有支配力的
meanings.usage: 用来描述人、事物或因素对他人/事件有重要影响，可修饰抽象名词（如factor, idea）或具体名词（如person, organization）
表示某物/某事对结果有决定性作用，常见搭配为be critical to/for sth
表示对人或事持否定评价，常见搭配为be critical of sb/sth
指发展过程中的一个特定阶段，常见搭配为phase of sth，enter/go through a phase
描述人类社会发展的早期阶段，或简陋、未发展的状态
指对某事的所有权、真实性等提出异议或争夺，常见搭配为dispute sth with sb
指两方或多方的争执，常见搭配为be in dispute over sth
表示通过力量或手段控制人、动物或事物，正式用语
指排出积水的系统或排水的动作、过程
指对未来的情形进行想象或预期，常见搭配为envision sth / envision doing sth
地理术语，指地球表面某点与赤道的南北距离，对应反义词为longitude（经度）
指长期居住在某个地区的人或动物，同义词为resident

meanings.meaning: 异端分子，持异端邪说的人
meanings.usage: 历史上指违背宗教正统教义的人，现在也可引申指持与主流不同观点的人
指在脑中形成想法、想象某种情形，常见搭配为conceive of sth / conceive that...
原本指注射液体，引申为将某种思想、活力等引入某个群体或环境，常见搭配为inject sth into sb/sth
用于加强语气，修饰形容词或动词，通常带有较强的感情色彩
描述想法、作品或人具有新颖的、与众不同的特点

phrases.phrase: make a poor show of (doing) sth
phrases.usage: 表示在做某事时表现得很糟糕、笨拙，口语和书面语中都可使用，带有调侃或自嘲的语气

examples.en: I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear.
examples.zh: 要是我和一头熊争夺一个山洞的所有权，我肯定会表现得十分狼狈。

examples.en: He made a poor show of apologizing, so no one was convinced.
examples.zh: 他道歉的样子十分敷衍，所以没有人相信他。

phrases.usage: 此处表示“孤立无援，只有自己一人（处于某种情况）”，也可指某事物独一无二、无人能及

examples.en: In this I do not think that I stand alone.
examples.zh: 在这一点上，我觉得并非只有我一个人是这样。

examples.en: When it comes to solving complex mathematical problems, he stands alone in his class.
examples.zh: 在解决复杂数学问题这方面，他在班里无人能及。

phrases.usage: 表示“受……的制约、影响”，通常指环境、习俗等外部因素对人的思想、行为产生塑造作用

examples.en: Our environment is chiefly conditioned by the things we believe.
examples.zh: 我们的环境主要由我们所信奉的事物塑造。

examples.en: People's consumption habits are conditioned by their income level.
examples.zh: 人们的消费习惯受其收入水平的制约。

phrases.usage: 表示“与其说是……不如说是……”，用于否定前者、强调后者，说明某结果的主要原因

examples.en: Yet their present development is wholly different, not so much because of different people even, but because of the different thoughts that exist in the minds of their inhabitants.
examples.zh: 然而它们现在的发展完全不同，与其说是因为人种不同，不如说是因为当地居民头脑中的思想不同。

examples.en: The project failed, not so much because of lack of funding, but because of poor management.
examples.zh: 这个项目失败了，与其说是因为资金不足，不如说是因为管理不善。

phrases.usage: 表示“非常清楚，深知”，强调对某事了解得十分透彻，口语和书面语通用

examples.en: The Holy Office knew this full well when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by.
examples.zh: 宗教法庭对此心知肚明，所以过去才会把异端分子烧死。

examples.en: She knew full well that he was lying, but she didn't point it out on the spot.
examples.zh: 她非常清楚他在撒谎，但并没有当场指出来。

phrases.usage: 表示“在过去，从前”，属于书面正式表达，用于指代已经过去的历史时期

examples.en: In days gone by, people had to fetch water from wells every day.
examples.zh: 从前，人们每天都得从井里打水。

phrases.usage: 表示“更准确地说”，用于对前面提到的内容进行补充修正，使表述更严谨

examples.en: We cannot think outside the particular patterns that our brains are conditioned to, or, to be more accurate we can think only a very little way outside.
examples.zh: 我们无法跳出大脑受制约形成的特定思维模式，或者更准确地说，我们只能稍微跳出一点这种模式。

examples.en: The meeting will end next week, to be more accurate, next Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 会议将在下周结束，更准确地说，是下周五下午。

sentences.en: In man's early days, competition with other creatures must have been critical.
sentences.zh: 在人类早期，与其他生物的竞争一定是至关重要的。

sentences.en: But this phase of our development is now finished.
sentences.zh: 但我们发展的这个阶段现在已经结束了。

sentences.en: Indeed, we lack practice and experience nowadays in dealing with primitive conditions.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们现在缺乏处理原始条件的实践和经验。

sentences.en: I am sure that, without modern weapons,
sentences.zh: 我确信，如果没有现代武器，

sentences.en: I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear, and in this I do not think that I stand alone.
sentences.zh: 我在与熊争夺洞穴所有权方面会表现得很糟糕，而且我认为我并非孤身一人。

sentences.en: The last creature to compete with man was the mosquito.
sentences.zh: 最后一种与人类竞争的生物是蚊子。

sentences.en: But even the mosquito has been subdued by attention to drainage and by chemical sprays.
sentences.zh: 但即使是蚊子也因对排水的重视和化学喷雾而被制服了。

sentences.en: Competition between ourselves, person against person,
sentences.zh: 我们彼此之间的竞争，人与人之间，

sentences.en: community against community, still persists, however; and it is as fierce as it ever was.
sentences.zh: 社群与社群之间，仍然存在；而且它和以往一样激烈。

sentences.en: But the competition of man against man is not the simple process envisioned in biology.
sentences.zh: 但人与人之间的竞争并不是生物学中设想的简单过程。

sentences.en: It is not a simple competition for a fixed amount of food determined by the physical environment,
sentences.zh: 这不是一种由物理环境决定的对固定数量食物的简单竞争，

sentences.en: because the environment that determines our evolution is no longer essentially physical.
sentences.zh: 因为决定我们进化的环境本质上不再是物理的了。

sentences.en: Our environment is chiefly conditoned by the things we believe.
sentences.zh: 我们的环境主要由我们所相信的事物所决定。

sentences.en: Morocco and California are bits of the Earth in very similar latitudes,
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥和加利福尼亚是地球上纬度非常相似的两个地方，

sentences.en: both on the west coasts of continents with similar climates, and probably with rather similar natural resources.
sentences.zh: 都位于大陆西海岸，气候相似，而且可能拥有相当相似的自然资源。

sentences.en: Yet their present development is wholly different,
sentences.zh: 然而，它们目前的发展却截然不同，

sentences.en: not so much because of different people even,
sentences.zh: 甚至不是因为不同的人，

sentences.en: but because of the different thoughts that exist in the minds of their inhabitants.
sentences.zh: 而是因为其居民心中存在的不同思想。

sentences.en: This is the point I wish to emphasize.
sentences.zh: 这就是我希望强调的重点。

sentences.en: The most important factor in our environment is the state of our own minds.
sentences.zh: 我们环境中最重要的因素是我们自己的心智状态。

sentences.en: It is well known that where the white man has invaded a primitive culture,
sentences.zh: 众所周知，当白人侵入原始文化时，

sentences.en: the most destructive effects have come not from physical weapons but from ideas.
sentences.zh: 最具破坏性的影响并非来自实体武器，而是来自思想。

sentences.en: Ideas are dangerous.
sentences.zh: 思想是危险的。

sentences.en: The Holy Office knew this full well when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by.
sentences.zh: 过去的异端裁判所对此心知肚明，因为它曾将异教徒烧死。

sentences.en: Indeed, the concept of free speech only exists in our modern society because when you are inside a community,
sentences.zh: 事实上，言论自由的概念之所以存在于我们的现代社会，是因为当你身处一个社群中时，

sentences.en: you are conditioned by the conventions of the community to such a degree that it is very difficult to conceive of anything really destructive.
sentences.zh: 你被社群的习俗所制约，以至于很难构想出任何真正具有破坏性的事物。

sentences.en: It is only someone looking on from outside that can inject the dangerous thoughts.
sentences.zh: 只有旁观者才能注入危险的思想。

sentences.en: I do not doubt that it would be possible to inject ideas into the modern world that would utterly destroy us.
sentences.zh: 我不怀疑有可能向现代世界注入彻底摧毁我们的思想。

sentences.en: I would like to give you an example, but fortunately I cannot do so.
sentences.zh: 我想给你们举个例子，但幸运的是我不能。

sentences.en: Perhaps it will suffice to mention the nuclear bomb.
sentences.zh: 也许提到核弹就足够了。

sentences.en: Imagine the effect on a reasonably advanced technological society,
sentences.zh: 想象一下，对一个相当先进的科技社会，

sentences.en: one that still does not possess the bomb, of making it aware of the possibility, of supplying suffcient details to enable the thing to be constructed.
sentences.zh: 一个尚未拥有核弹的社会，如果让它意识到可能性，并提供足够的细节使其能够被建造出来，那会产生什么影响。

sentences.en: 20 or 30 pages of information handed to any of the major world powers around the year 1925,
sentences.zh: 1925年左右，将20或30页信息交给任何一个世界主要大国，

sentences.en: would have been sufficient to change the course of world history.
sentences.zh: 足以改变世界历史的进程。

sentences.en: It is a strange thought, but I believe a correct one,
sentences.zh: 这是一个奇怪的想法，但我相信它是正确的，

sentences.en: that twenty or thirty pages of ideas and information would be capable of turning the present-day world upside down, or even destroying it.
sentences.zh: 即二三十页的思想和信息就足以颠覆当今世界，甚至摧毁它。

sentences.en: I have often tried to conceive of what those pages might contain,
sentences.zh: 我曾多次试图构想那些页面可能包含什么，

sentences.en: but of course I cannot do so because I am a prisoner of the present-day world, just as all of you are.
sentences.zh: 但我当然做不到，因为我是当今世界的囚徒，就像你们所有人一样。

sentences.en: We cannot think outside the particular patterns that our brains are conditioned to, or,
sentences.zh: 我们无法跳出我们大脑被制约的特定模式进行思考，或者说，

sentences.en: to be more accurate we can think only a very little way outside and then only if we are very original.
sentences.zh: 更准确地说，我们只能稍微跳出一点，而且只有当我们非常具有原创性时才能做到。

grammar.title: 虚拟语气用于对过去的推测
grammar.definition: 表示对过去发生的事情的可能性进行主观推测，并非描述客观事实，常用来表达肯定性的判断
grammar.usage: 用于推测过去肯定发生了某件事，语气非常肯定，通常有一定的依据

examples.en: In man's early days, competition with other creatures must have been critical.
examples.zh: 在人类早期，和其他生物的竞争肯定是至关重要的。

examples.en: The ground is wet, so it must have rained last night.
examples.zh: 地面是湿的，所以昨晚肯定下雨了。

grammar.title: 虚拟条件句（与现在事实相反）
grammar.definition: 用来描述与当前现实不相符的假设情况，以及该假设会产生的结果，假设的内容不可能或很难发生
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 动词过去式（be动词用were）, 主语 + would/could/might + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于表达对现实的假设、想象，句子描述的内容并非真实发生的情况

examples.en: I am sure that, without modern weapons, I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear.
examples.zh: 我敢肯定，如果没有现代武器，要是我和一头熊争夺一个山洞的所有权，我肯定会表现得十分狼狈。

examples.en: If I were you, I would choose to study abroad after graduation.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会选择毕业后出国留学。

grammar.title: 分隔式定语从句
grammar.definition: 指定语从句和它所修饰的先行词被其他成分隔开，目的是保持句子结构平衡，避免头重脚轻
grammar.structure: 先行词 + 其他成分 + 关系词 + 定语从句
grammar.usage: 当先行词后面的定语从句过长，或先行词后有其他必要的修饰成分时，会将定语从句后置，和先行词分隔

examples.en: I do not doubt that it would be possible to inject ideas into the modern world that would utterly destroy us.
examples.zh: 我毫不怀疑，向现代世界注入一些会彻底摧毁我们的思想是有可能的。（定语从句that would utterly destroy us修饰先行词ideas，被状语into the modern world隔开）

examples.en: A new teacher will come tomorrow who will teach us English.
examples.zh: 明天会来一位新老师，教我们英语。（定语从句who will teach us English修饰先行词teacher，被时间状语tomorrow隔开）

patterns.pattern: The most + 形容词 + factor in + 领域/范围 is + 名词/名词短语

original.en: The most important factor in our environment is the state of our own minds.
original.zh: 我们环境中最重要的因素是我们自身的思想状态。

examples.en: The most critical factor in learning a language well is consistent daily practice.
examples.zh: 学好一门语言最重要的因素是每天持续的练习。

examples.en: The most influential factor in a company's long-term development is its corporate culture.
examples.zh: 一家公司长期发展最有影响力的因素是它的企业文化。

patterns.pattern: It is well known that where + 状语从句, the most + 形容词 + effects have come not from + 名词, but from + 名词

original.en: It is well known that where the white man has invaded a primitive culture, the most destructive effects have come not from physical weapons but from ideas.
original.zh: 众所周知，凡是白人入侵原始文化的地方，最具破坏性的影响并非来自物质武器，而是来自思想。

examples.en: It is well known that where natural disasters occur, the most needed supplies come not from individual donations, but from government support.
examples.zh: 众所周知，在发生自然灾害的地方，最急需的物资并非来自个人捐赠，而是来自政府扶持。

examples.en: It is well known that where education is highly valued, the most obvious progress comes not from government investment alone, but from the participation of the whole society.
examples.zh: 众所周知，在高度重视教育的地方，最显著的进步并非只来自政府投入，而是来自全社会的参与。

patterns.pattern: It is a strange thought, but I believe a correct one, that + 同位语从句

original.en: It is a strange thought, but I believe a correct one, that twenty or thirty pages of ideas and information would be capable of turning the present-day world upside down, or even destroying it.
original.zh: 二三十页的思想和信息就能把当今世界搅得天翻地覆，甚至将其摧毁，这是一个奇怪的想法，但我认为是正确的。

examples.en: It is a surprising thought, but I believe a correct one, that a small habit we stick to every day can change the trajectory of our entire life.
examples.zh: 我们每天坚持的一个小习惯就能改变整个人生的轨迹，这是一个惊人的想法，但我认为是正确的。

examples.en: It is a counterintuitive thought, but I believe a correct one, that sometimes slowing down is the fastest way to achieve our goals.
examples.zh: 有时候放慢速度反而是实现目标最快的方式，这是一个违反直觉的想法，但我认为是正确的。
